title: Spyglass: Officially Launched and Ready for You
summary: After extensive development and successful beta testing, the powerful Spyglass tool is now fully launched and available, empowering you with its robust capabilities.

title: Enhanced File Management and Display
summary: Gain complete control over your content with new tools to easily manage, upload, and customize how your files and images appear directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Your New Public Roadmap!
summary: Explore our brand-new public roadmap to effortlessly track our progress, see what's currently in development, and peek into exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've rolled out a significant upgrade to our checkboxes, making them bigger, easier to click, visually stunning, and effortlessly draggable for superior task management.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded the collaborative editing experience, making it easier and more intuitive to work together seamlessly with your team.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: Easily find and collaborate on all items shared with you, making teamwork more intuitive and efficient.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're opening Noeko's codebase to empower our community with greater control, transparency, and direct involvement in shaping its future.

title: Global Language Accessibility
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce comprehensive international language support, welcoming a global community.

title: Elevate Your Style: Enhanced Themes & New Designs
summary: We're giving Noeko a stunning visual upgrade by refining our existing themes and introducing exciting new options to personalize your experience.

title: Dynamic Constellation View
summary: Navigate your knowledge with unprecedented clarity using our enhanced Constellation View, featuring powerful new filters for tags, time, and shared connections.

title: Enhanced Search & Saved Collections
summary: Efficiently locate and organize your most important information with robust new filtering options and the ability to save your refined search results as personalized collections.

title: Dynamic Linked Content Views
summary: Unlock a more intuitive and organized workflow with dynamic new ways to display your linked notes, tasks, and sources.

title: Noeko: Launching with Flexible Hosting and Premium Power
summary: Prepare to transform your workflow as Noeko officially launches, offering the flexibility to host it yourself or utilize our convenient cloud service, alongside powerful new premium features.

title: Smarter Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your welcome messages on the homepage always reflect the correct time of day, making your experience even more personal and precise.

title: Streamlined Management for Tagged Items
summary: Effortlessly perform actions like unapplying tags, deleting items, and more directly from your list views, making item management faster and more intuitive.

title: Diverse Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in and organize insights from a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your knowledge base like never before.
